annotations.title: Walkability score for an address or point

description: How walkable one street spot in Europe is (31 countries). Give an address, or lat and lon. Returns the Walkably score from 0 to 100 (60% reach, 40% street quality; a street quality under 40 caps the score at 69; the score is never more than 10 points above reach), the reach and street-quality parts, the share of the country's places it beats, minutes on foot along real streets to each of eight daily needs (groceries, food and drink, shops, health, school, parks, culture, transit) with the nearest place and a Europe-wide verdict, and a link to the spot on the map. Each score covers a six-sided street cell about 95 m across. Addresses are looked up with Photon (komoot), a free OpenStreetMap address search. This server is for single places in a conversation. Lists of addresses and bulk use go through the Walkably API: https://walkably.org/business/api/

address.description: Street address or place, e.g. "Carrer de Blai 20, Barcelona". Use this or lat and lon.

lat.description: Latitude in degrees (WGS84). Use with lon instead of address.
